title: ischaemum lanuginosum
intro: Ischaemum lanuginosum, commonly known as 'Fountain Grass', is a type of ornamental grass native to tropical Asia and Australia. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ischaemum lanuginosum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
